notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Planned for Launch
notes.content: This is a note to ensure that it is clear that I have every intention of fully supporting the Steam Deck at launch. As a busy parent, most of my gaming time is on the Steam Deck these days, and I think that a party game absolutely needs to be able to be played on the Deck.  Being able to bring the deck around to a gathering with a printed manual is a perfect way to play this game, and (along with online over Discord) one of the main ways I'm play testing.
